## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what changes for a user or contributor. Link the issue
if there is one. Thai or English is welcome.

## Validation

List relevant commands and actual results, including failures, skips and unrun
checks. For documentation-only changes, explain why application tests are not
needed. Synthetic tests are not evidence of a real Colab or release run.

## Compatibility and limitations

Mention input-contract, workspace/recovery, security or release implications,
plus any known unresolved failures. Use synthetic examples and sanitized logs.

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and included enough information to review this change.
- [ ] I kept credentials and real financial data out of the change and its evidence.
